items.title: 1.5.3 Using UML to Represent Software Systems

source_refs.note: Topic printed 1.5.3 Using UML to Represent Software Systems (PDF 24-25, printed 21-22); numbering slip.

blocks.text: UML can be used at various stages of software development to improve understanding and communication.

items: Planning: use UML diagrams to map out the system's requirements and design before writing any code.
Development: developers refer to UML diagrams to understand the structure and relationships within the system.
Communication: UML diagrams help team members, including non-technical stakeholders, understand how the system works.

blocks.prompt: Give one use of UML before coding and one during development.
blocks.explanation: Before coding, UML maps out the requirements and design; during development, programmers consult the diagrams to understand the system's structure and relationships.

items: UML in practice: planning (requirements and design before code), development (structure and relationships), communication (including non-technical stakeholders).
